title: Blueberry Smoothie with Chia and Flaxseed
excerpt: Enjoy a creamy, refreshing smoothie that combines fresh blueberries with chia and flaxseed. A delicious, easy-to-make option to start your mornings.
imageAlt: A tall glass of blueberry, chia and flaxseed smoothie, topped with fresh blueberries.
steps: In a small bowl, soak the chia seeds and ground flaxseed in 4 tablespoons of water or milk for 5 minutes so they hydrate.
Add the Fresh Pick blueberries to the blender, grown in the cold mountains of Guasca more than 2,800 meters above sea level to ensure their natural sweetness.
Add the hydrated chia and flaxseed along with the almond milk, honey and vanilla extract.
Add the ice cubes to give the mixture freshness and body.
Blend on high speed for 1 to 2 minutes until you get a creamy, even texture.
Serve right away in two tall glasses and enjoy a delicious drink.
tips: You can freeze the washed and dried Fresh Pick blueberries beforehand to get a much thicker smoothie without adding extra ice.
Using ground flaxseed instead of whole seeds keeps the smoothie smooth and silky to drink.
